Testers often hit problems before using any command: double-clicking

commitResults.messageTitle: Add an issue template for alpha-test bug reports
commitResults.messageBody:
Give testers a form with steps, expected and actual results, and a
short guide to the type and severity labels. Issues created from it get
the alpha-bug label automatically, so no report is left out of the
count.

commitResults.messageTitle: Turn the alpha bug template into an issue form
commitResults.messageBody:
An issue form makes steps, expected and actual results required fields,
and offers type and severity as dropdowns instead of comments testers
have to read.

commitResults.messageTitle: Label alpha bugs from their type and severity answers
commitResults.messageBody:
The form's type options did not match our type.* labels, and testers
had to add the labels by hand. Offer Bug and Enhancement, which match
our labels, and add a workflow that reads the Type and Severity answers
of an alpha-bug issue and applies the matching labels. "Not sure"
adds no label, leaving it to the feature's author.
Add an alpha bug issue form that labels type and severity automatically

commitResults.messageTitle: Treat null client and tag entries as corrupted data
commitResults.messageBody:
A data file with a null entry in its clients list, e.g. {"clients":[null]},
crashed PawPals at startup with a NullPointerException instead of
starting with an empty client list as the UG describes. Report null
client and tag entries as invalid data, like null pets, appointments
and history entries already are.

commitResults.messageTitle: Treat repeated spaces in a breed as one space
commitResults.messageBody:
Pet names and species collapse repeated spaces, but breeds only
trimmed them, so "Golden  Retriever" was stored differently from
"Golden Retriever". Normalise breeds the same way and say so in the UG.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove the test that expected breeds to keep repeated spaces
commitResults.messageBody:
Breeds now collapse repeated spaces, which the new
constructor_repeatedSpaces_collapsesToOneSpace test checks, so the old
test asserting the previous behaviour no longer applies.

commitResults.messageTitle: Require pet names, species and breeds to contain a letter or number
commitResults.messageBody:
Values made only of symbols, such as "'" or "---", were accepted as
pet names, species and breeds. Require at least one letter or number
in each, and update the User Guide to match.

commitResults.messageTitle: Allow full stops in pet names, species and breeds
commitResults.messageBody:
Common values such as "Mr. Snuffles", "St. Bernard" and "Cat sp." were
rejected because full stops were not allowed. Allow full stops in pet
names, species and breeds, and update the User Guide to match.

commitResults.messageTitle: Say editp and delp update all active appointments
commitResults.messageBody:
Appointments can now be in the past, so "upcoming appointments" no
longer describes which appointments editp and delp update. They update
every active appointment.

commitResults.messageTitle: Check appointment pet links when loading the data file
commitResults.messageBody:
A hand-edited data file could link an appointment to a pet the client
does not have, or name the same pet twice in different case. PawPals
loaded these as they were, so client cards listed pets that do not
exist, and a pet added later with that name was linked silently.

Reject links to unknown pets as corrupted data, and store each link
under the pet's recorded name once.

commitResults.messageTitle: Clean up spaces in pet fields before checking them on load
commitResults.messageBody:
Loading a pet checked the raw name, species and breed from the data
file before trimming and collapsing spaces. A 38-character name with
trailing spaces, or a name ending in a tab, went over the limit or
failed the check, so the whole file was rejected, although the same
value typed into addp is accepted.

Let the PetName, Species and Breed constructors clean up and check
each value, as typed commands already do.
